title: Environment 2
note: B2 vocab leaf, drafted 2026-09-05 on the home lane. b1_environment (36) is unusually complete for a B1 unit — climate change, global warming, fossil fuel, coal, emissions, carbon, deforestation, drought, flood, landfill, renewable, solar power, wind farm, nuclear, conservation, wildlife, habitat, species, endangered, extinct, glacier, soil, atmosphere, sustainable — so the first sweep of 39 obvious candidates returned only 19 clean. Half the topic was already taught. Two further sweeps were needed to reach 36, which is the clearest case yet of DRAFTING's warning that the obvious vocabulary for a theme is usually already there. The layer that survives is more specific and more current: the chemistry of the damage (greenhouse gas, carbon dioxide, methane, erosion, contamination, smog, acid rain), what is actually being lost (biodiversity, ecosystem, extinction, coral reef, rainforest, scarcity, consumption), and what is being done or claimed about it (sustainability, carbon footprint, carbon neutral, offset, recycling, biodegradable, single-use, reforestation, eco-friendly, greenwashing). C57 card 0 recaps Environment 1. C49 all 36 across three boards of 12. Build-the-family is half recap: sustainable and extinct are already the student's and this unit adds sustainability and extinction; contaminate -> contamination and consume -> consumption run inside the unit. All four derived forms are bank items. E10 Use is rewrite production; every underline reconstructs its answer.

cards.title: You already know
cards.note: Environment 1 was unusually full: climate change, global warming, fossil fuel, coal, emissions, carbon, deforestation, drought, flood, landfill, renewable, solar power, wind farm, nuclear, conservation, wildlife, habitat, species, endangered, extinct, glacier, soil, atmosphere, sustainable. Half of this subject is already yours, and those words carry the sentences here. What is new is more exact: what the damage is made of, what is actually being lost, and what people claim they are doing about it.
cards.note_cz: Environment 1 byla neobvykle plná: climate change, global warming, fossil fuel, coal, emissions, carbon, deforestation, drought, flood, landfill, renewable, solar power, wind farm, nuclear, conservation, wildlife, habitat, species, endangered, extinct, glacier, soil, atmosphere, sustainable. Polovina tématu už je tvoje a ta slova nesou zdejší věty. Nové je přesnější: z čeho se ta škoda skládá, co se doopravdy ztrácí a co lidé tvrdí, že s tím dělají.

sentences.en: Farming makes more greenhouse gas than people think.
sentences.cz: Zemědělství produkuje víc skleníkových plynů, než si lidé myslí.
accepts: Farming makes more greenhouse gas than people think

sentences.en: Trees take carbon dioxide out of the air.
sentences.cz: Stromy berou ze vzduchu oxid uhličitý.
accepts: Trees take carbon dioxide out of the air

sentences.en: Cows make methane, which warms the atmosphere.
sentences.cz: Krávy produkují metan, který ohřívá atmosféru.

sentences.cz: Skleníkový efekt drží planetu dost teplou.

sentences.cz: Eroze odnesla z těch polí půdu.

sentences.cz: Kontaminace se dostala do pitné vody.

sentences.en: Biodiversity falls when one habitat disappears.
sentences.cz: Biodiverzita klesá, když zmizí jeden biotop.

sentences.en: A small change can break the ecosystem.
sentences.cz: Malá změna může rozbít ekosystém.

sentences.en: Extinction is now faster than at any time before.
sentences.cz: Vyhynutí je teď rychlejší než kdy dřív.

sentences.en: Warmer water is destroying the coral reef.
sentences.cz: Teplejší voda ničí korálový útes.
accepts: Warmer water is destroying the coral reef

sentences.en: The rainforest holds more species than anywhere else.
sentences.cz: Deštný prales má víc druhů než kdekoli jinde.
accepts: The rainforest holds more species than anywhere else

sentences.en: The ozone above us is slowly getting better.
sentences.cz: Ozon nad námi se pomalu zlepšuje.
accepts: The ozone above us is slowly getting better

sentences.en: Water scarcity will decide where people live.
sentences.cz: Nedostatek vody rozhodne, kde budou lidé žít.
accepts: Water scarcity will decide where people live

sentences.en: Overpopulation is not the only problem here.
sentences.cz: Přelidnění tady není jediný problém.
accepts: Overpopulation is not the only problem here

sentences.en: Some countries consume far more than others.
sentences.cz: Některé země spotřebovávají mnohem víc než jiné.

sentences.en: Energy consumption fell during the warm winter.
sentences.cz: Spotřeba energie během teplé zimy klesla.

sentences.cz: Lepší zavlažování by ušetřilo polovinu vody.

sentences.en: Sustainability means thinking past the next year.
sentences.cz: Udržitelnost znamená myslet dál než na příští rok.
accepts: Sustainability means thinking past the next year

sentences.en: Flying gives him a huge carbon footprint.
sentences.cz: Létání mu dělá obrovskou uhlíkovou stopu.

sentences.en: They advertise the hotel as eco-friendly.

sentences.en: Much of that advertising is only greenwashing.
sentences.cz: Hodně z té reklamy je jen greenwashing.
